label: prf:categorical-lagrangian-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical Lagrangian
html:
The proof strategy rests on algebraic rigidity and the categorical action principle. We assume an arbitrary endomorphism in \mathrm{End}(A) that acts as a Lagrangian and show that enforcing the variational equations uniquely constrains it to be identical to L_q = D^2 + \psi^* \otimes D \psi.

\mathcal{D}_\nabla is unique by (uniqueness of Dirac operator), and \mathcal{D}_\nabla^2 is unique by composition. The adjoint \psi^* = \int_A \circ S(\psi) is unique given \psi and the QU antipode. The sum \mathcal{D}_\nabla^2 + \psi^* \otimes \mathcal{D}_\nabla \psi is therefore a single morphism in \mathrm{End}(A).
